name: colgrep --agent, recorded sessions
description: Watch colgrep-agent-2B search a repository, turn by turn

paragraphs: A terminal that replays recorded runs of colgrep-agent-2B, the 2B code-search agent behind colgrep --agent. Pick one of nine repositories from the SWE-bench Lite and Multi-SWE-bench Flash evaluation, pick one of the recorded questions, and watch the agent search with colgrep, read files and submit path:START-END locations with the code, in the format the real command prints. Each step expands to the recorded tool output, and the result is checked against the pull request that fixed the issue.
Nothing runs live. The calls and outputs are the ones recorded during evaluation (seed 1, temperature 0.6, 10-turn budget); the viewer only paces them.
